rows.source_ko: 식품의약품안전처 (위해예방정책과), 043-719-1721, 1717
rows.text_en: Ministry of Food and Drug Safety ( Risk Prevention Policy Division ), 043-719-1721, 1717

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「인체적용제품의 위해성평가에 관한 법률」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Risk Assessment of Products Applied to the Human Body and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(위해성평가의 방법 등) ① 식품의약품안전평가원장은 「인체적용제품의 위해성평가에 관한 법률」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제10조제1항에 따라 위해성평가를 수행한 경우에는 다음 각 호의 사항을 포함한 결과보고서를 작성해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Methods of Risk Assessment, etc.) ① When the Director of the Korea Food and Drug Administration conducts a risk assessment pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Act on Risk Assessment of Products Applied to the Human Body (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), he or she shall prepare a results report including the following items.

rows.source_ko: 1. 위해성평가를 한 인체적용제품 및 그 위해요소
rows.text_en: 1. Products for human application that have undergone risk assessment and their hazardous elements

rows.source_ko: 2. 위해성평가의 기간
rows.text_en: 2. Period of Risk Assessment

rows.source_ko: 3. 위해요소에 대한 화학적ㆍ생물학적ㆍ물리적 특성의 평가 및 독성정보
rows.text_en: 3. Evaluation of chemical, biological, and physical characteristics of hazardous elements and toxicity information

rows.source_ko: 4. 위해요소의 인체노출 안전기준
rows.text_en: 4. Safety standards for human exposure to hazardous substances

rows.source_ko: 5. 인체가 위해요소에 노출된 정도
rows.text_en: 5. The degree to which the human body is exposed to hazardous elements

rows.source_ko: 6. 위해요소가 인체에 미치는 위해성의 정도
rows.text_en: 6. Degree of harm caused by hazardous factors to the human body

rows.source_ko: ② 식품의약품안전평가원장은 법 제10조제2항 각 호 외의 부분 단서에 따라 다음 각 호에 따른 위해요소의 특성을 고려하여 위해성평가의 방법을 정한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Director of the Food and Drug Safety Evaluation Institute shall determine the method of risk assessment in consideration of the characteristics of the risk factors under each of the following subparagraphs, in accordance with the proviso to the part other than each subparagraph of Article 10, Paragraph 2 of the Act.

rows.source_ko: 1. 인체에 유해한 화학물질 등 화학적 요인
rows.text_en: 1. Chemical factors, such as chemicals harmful to the human body

rows.source_ko: 2. 생물 유래 독소 및 유해미생물 등 생물학적 요인
rows.text_en: 2. Biological factors such as biological toxins and harmful microorganisms

rows.source_ko: 3. 형태 및 이물(異物) 등 물리적 요인
rows.text_en: 3. Physical factors such as shape and foreign matter

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에서 규정한 사항 외에 위해성평가의 방법ㆍ기준 및 절차 등에 관하여 필요한 사항은 식품의약품안전처장이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 and 2, necessary matters concerning the methods, standards, and procedures, etc. of risk assessment shall be determined by the Minister of Food and Drug Safety .

rows.source_ko: 제3조(독성시험의 항목ㆍ방법 등) ① 식품의약품안전평가원장은 법 제11조에 따라 다음 각 호의 독성시험을 실시할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Items and Methods of Toxicity Tests, etc.) ① The Director of the Korea Food and Drug Administration may conduct the following toxicity tests in accordance with Article 11 of the Act.

rows.source_ko: 1. 단회투여독성시험
rows.text_en: 1. Single-dose toxicity test

rows.source_ko: 2. 반복투여독성시험
rows.text_en: 2. Repeated-dose toxicity test

rows.source_ko: 3. 생식ㆍ발생독성시험
rows.text_en: 3. Reproductive and developmental toxicity tests

rows.source_ko: 4. 유전독성시험
rows.text_en: 4. Genotoxicity test

rows.source_ko: 5. 항원성시험
rows.text_en: 5. Antigenicity test

rows.source_ko: 6. 면역독성시험
rows.text_en: 6. Immunotoxicity Test

rows.source_ko: 7. 발암성시험
rows.text_en: 7. Carcinogenicity test

rows.source_ko: 8. 국소독성시험
rows.text_en: 8. Local toxicity test

rows.source_ko: 9. 흡입독성시험
rows.text_en: 9. Inhalation Toxicity Test

rows.source_ko: 10. 그 밖에 인체적용제품 특성에 따른 독성시험
rows.text_en: 10. Other toxicity tests based on the characteristics of products applied to the human body

rows.source_ko: ② 식품의약품안전평가원장은 제1항에 따라 실시된 독성시험의 결과에 대하여 전문가의 검증을 거칠 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② The Director of the Food and Drug Safety Evaluation Institute may have the results of the toxicity test conducted pursuant to Paragraph 1 verified by experts.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에서 규정한 사항 외에 독성시험의 절차ㆍ방법과 독성시험 결과의 검증에 필요한 세부 사항은 식품의약품안전처장이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 and 2, the Minister of Food and Drug Safety shall determine the procedures and methods for toxicity testing and the details necessary for verification of toxicity test results .

rows.source_ko: 제4조(출입ㆍ조사ㆍ수거 등) ① 법 제12조제1항에 따라 출입ㆍ조사ㆍ수거를 하려는 관계 공무원은 인체적용제품별로 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 증표를 관계인에게 제시해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Entry, Inspection, Collection, etc.) ① Any public official intending to enter, inspect, or collect pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall present identification to the persons concerned according to the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs for each product applied to the human body.

rows.source_ko: 1. 식품, 식품첨가물, 기구 및 용기ㆍ포장: 「식품위생법」 제22조제3항에 따른 증표
rows.text_en: 1. Food, food additives, equipment, and containers/packaging: Certificate pursuant to Article 22, Paragraph 3 of the Food Sanitation Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 축산물: 「축산물 위생관리법」 제19조제4항에 따른 증표
rows.text_en: 2. Livestock products: Certificate pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 4 of the Livestock Products Sanitation Management Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 건강기능식품: 「건강기능식품에 관한 법률」 제20조제2항에 따른 증표
rows.text_en: 3. Health Functional Food: Certificate pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 2 of the "Act on Health Functional Foods"

rows.source_ko: 4. 의약품 또는 의약외품: 「약사법」 제69조제2항에 따른 증표
rows.text_en: 4. Pharmaceuticals or quasi-pharmaceuticals: Certificate pursuant to Article 69, Paragraph 2 of the Pharmaceutical Affairs Act

rows.source_ko: 5. 마약류: 「마약류 관리에 관한 법률」 제41조제3항에 따른 증표
rows.text_en: 5. Narcotics: Identification pursuant to Article 41, Paragraph 3 of the Act on the Management of Narcotics

rows.source_ko: 6. 화장품: 「화장품법」 제18조제4항에 따른 증표
rows.text_en: 6. Cosmetics: Certificate pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 4 of the Cosmetics Act

rows.source_ko: 7. 의료기기: 「의료기기법」 제32조제2항에 따른 증표
rows.text_en: 7. Medical device: Certificate pursuant to Article 32, Paragraph 2 of the Medical Devices Act

rows.source_ko: 8. 위생용품: 「위생용품 관리법」 제14조제3항에 따른 증표
rows.text_en: 8. Sanitary products: Certificate pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 3 of the Sanitary Products Management Act

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제12조제1항에 따라 인체적용제품을 수거한 관계 공무원은 인체적용제품별로 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 수거증을 피수거인에게 발급해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② In accordance with Article 12, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the relevant public official who has collected products for human application shall issue a collection certificate to the person to whom the products are collected, according to the classification in each of the following subparagraphs for each product for human application.

rows.source_ko: 1. 식품, 식품첨가물, 기구 및 용기ㆍ포장: 「식품위생법 시행규칙」 제20조제2항에 따른 수거증
rows.text_en: 1. Food, food additives, equipment, and containers/packaging: Collection certificate pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Rules of the Food Sanitation Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 축산물: 「축산물 위생관리법 시행규칙」 제26조제2항에 따른 수거증
rows.text_en: 2. Livestock products: Collection certificate pursuant to Article 26, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Rule of the Livestock Products Sanitation Management Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 건강기능식품: 「건강기능식품에 관한 법률 시행규칙」 제23조제2항에 따른 수거증
rows.text_en: 3. Health Functional Foods: Collection certificate pursuant to Article 23, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Rule of the Act on Health Functional Foods

rows.source_ko: 4. 의약품 또는 의약외품: 「의약품 등의 안전에 관한 규칙」 제86조제1항에 따른 수거증
rows.text_en: 4. Pharmaceuticals or quasi-pharmaceuticals: Collection certificate pursuant to Article 86, Paragraph 1 of the "Rules on the Safety of Pharmaceuticals, etc."

rows.source_ko: 5. 마약류: 「마약류 관리에 관한 법률 시행규칙」 제42조에 따른 수거증
rows.text_en: 5. Narcotics: Collection certificate pursuant to Article 42 of the Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Management of Narcotics

rows.source_ko: 6. 화장품: 「화장품법 시행규칙」 제25조에 따른 수거증
rows.text_en: 6. Cosmetics: Collection certificate pursuant to Article 25 of the Enforcement Rule of the Cosmetics Act

rows.source_ko: 7. 의료기기: 「의료기기법 시행규칙」 제55조제1항에 따른 수거증
rows.text_en: 7. Medical device: Collection certificate pursuant to Article 55, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Rule of the Medical Devices Act

rows.source_ko: 8. 위생용품: 「위생용품 관리법 시행규칙」 제21조제2항에 따른 수거증
rows.text_en: 8. Sanitary products: Collection certificate pursuant to Article 21, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Rule of the Sanitary Products Management Act

rows.source_ko: ③ 관계 공무원은 법 제12조제1항에 따라 수거한 인체적용제품을 수거 장소에서 봉함ㆍ봉인(封印)해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Public officials must seal the human application products collected pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 1 of the Act at the collection site.

rows.source_ko: ④ 지방식품의약품안전청장은 법 제12조제1항에 따라 수거한 인체적용제품에 대해 「식품ㆍ의약품분야 시험ㆍ검사 등에 관한 법률」 제6조제1항에 따라 지정된 시험ㆍ검사기관에 검사를 의뢰할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ④ The head of the regional Food and Drug Administration may request an inspection of human-use products collected pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 1 of the Act to a testing and inspection agency designated pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act on Testing and Inspection in Food and Drug Fields .

rows.source_ko: 제5조(위해성평가 요청서) 법 제16조제1항 및 같은 법 시행령 제10조제3항에 따라 인체적용제품에 대한 위해성평가를 요청하려는 자는 별지 서식의 위해성평가 요청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 식품의약품안전처장에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Request for Risk Assessment) Any person who intends to request a risk assessment for a product for human use pursuant to Article 16 , Paragraph 1 of the Act and Article 10, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act shall submit a request for risk assessment in the attached form to the Minister of Food and Drug Safety, attaching the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 위해성평가 요청자의 신분을 확인할 수 있는 증명서(소비자단체인 경우 「소비자기본법 시행령」 제23조제5항에 따른 소비자단체 등록증을 말한다)
rows.text_en: 1. A certificate verifying the identity of the requester for the risk assessment (in the case of a consumer organization, this refers to the consumer organization registration certificate pursuant to Article 23, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on Consumers).

rows.source_ko: 2. 그 밖에 요청사유 등을 설명하는 데 필요한 참고자료
rows.text_en: 2. Other reference materials necessary to explain the reasons for the request, etc.

rows.source_ko: 제6조(인체적용제품 이상사례 조사 등) ① 법 제17조에 따른 인체적용제품 이상사례 조사의 대상은 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Investigation of Adverse Events of Products Applied to the Human Body, etc.) ① The subjects of the investigation of adverse events of products applied to the human body pursuant to Article 17 of the Act are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 「건강기능식품에 관한 법률」 제10조의2에 따라 보고된 이상사례
rows.text_en: 1. Adverse events reported pursuant to Article 10-2 of the Act on Health Functional Foods

rows.source_ko: 2. 「약사법」 제68조의8, 「의료기기법」 제31조 및 「화장품법 시행규칙」 제12조제10호ㆍ제12조의2제5호에 따라 보고된 부작용 사례
rows.text_en: 2. Cases of adverse effects reported pursuant to Article 68-8 of the Pharmaceutical Affairs Act , Article 31 of the Medical Devices Act , and Article 12, Subparagraph 10 and Article 12-2, Subparagraph 5 of the Enforcement Rules of the Cosmetics Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 인체적용제품으로 인하여 발생한 이상사례로서 식품의약품안전처장이 조사가 필요하다고 인정한 사례
rows.text_en: 3. Other adverse events caused by products applied to the human body that the Minister of Food and Drug Safety deems necessary to investigate.

rows.source_ko: ② 식품의약품안전평가원장은 법 제17조에 따른 인체적용제품 이상사례를 조사하는 경우 이상사례 발생 빈도, 위해요소의 위해 정도 및 시급성 등을 고려해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When investigating adverse events of products for human use pursuant to Article 17 of the Act , the Director of the Food and Drug Safety Evaluation Institute shall consider the frequency of occurrence of adverse events, the degree of harm and urgency of the risk factors, etc.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에서 규정한 사항 외에 이상사례 조사의 방법ㆍ절차 등에 관하여 필요한 세부 사항은 식품의약품안전처장이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 and 2, the Minister of Food and Drug Safety shall determine the necessary detailed matters regarding the methods and procedures for investigating adverse events .

rows.source_ko: 제7조(교육ㆍ홍보) ① 법 제19조제1항에 따른 교육ㆍ홍보의 주요 내용은 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Education and Promotion) ① The main contents of education and promotion pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 1 of the Act are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 인체적용제품의 안전관리에 대한 이해도 향상
rows.text_en: 1. Improvement in understanding of safety management for products applied to the human body

rows.source_ko: 2. 인체적용제품의 안전관리에 대한 자발적 실천
rows.text_en: 2. Voluntary implementation of safety management for products applied to the human body

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제19조제1항에 따른 교육은 대면교육 또는 정보통신망을 활용한 온라인 교육으로 실시한다.
rows.text_en: ② Education pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be conducted as face-to-face education or online education using information and communication networks.

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제19조제1항에 따른 홍보의 방법은 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: ③ The methods of promotion pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 1 of the Act are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 정보통신매체를 이용하는 방법
rows.text_en: 1. Method of using information and communication media

rows.source_ko: 2. 현장실습 등의 체험활동을 이용하는 방법
rows.text_en: 2. How to use experiential activities such as field training

rows.source_ko: 3. 「방송법」 제73조제4항에 따른 비상업적 공익광고를 활용하는 방법
rows.text_en: 3. Method of utilizing non-commercial public service advertisements pursuant to Article 73 , Paragraph 4 of the Broadcasting Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 소비자단체의 홍보활동을 지원하는 방법
rows.text_en: 4. Methods to support the promotional activities of consumer organizations
ADDENDA <Prime Minister's Decree No. 1787, Jan. 26, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 이 규칙은 2022년 1월 28일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: This rule shall take effect on January 28, 2022.

rows.source_ko: [별지서식] 위해성평가 요청서
rows.text_en: [Attached Form] Request for Risk Assessment
